item.title: Rate Market Fear Gauge Is Warning for Corporates
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: For now, company profits are strong and higher overall corporate bond yields in part reflect solid economic growth. But, as inflationary pressure builds, the Federal Reserve is boosting rates to slow that growth. Over time, higher rates can hurt the economy and squeeze profits, and corporate bonds are already priced with little margin for error, said Kelly Kowalski, head of investment strategy at MassMutual.
